These establish sampled relationships; they do not establish clean connection contact, exact input forces or uninterrupted playback. Connection-contact reference evidence remains NOT_ASSESSED. Replacement production BEFORE, CONTACT and AFTER proofs also remain NOT_ASSESSED and block advancement until reviewed. Transfer only these principles, never reference artwork, characters or apparatus. This patch replaces only s02-connected-work and b02–b04. The eight unaffected setups, exact script and other token records remain locked. Before implementation, archive the rejected plan and its failed evidence; archival has not been performed here. All new artwork, contact bindings and actions below are proposed agent-assisted capabilities, not registered functionality or executable choreography. The moving-repair budget remains unconsumed.
